title: Cool stuff, but a bit overpriced
text:
While there is some neat stuff I'm sure my husband will like when I give it to him for Christmas (yes, I started early), I feel like it is a bit overpriced for "highly collectible" items. The box items are cool, but I will be waiting to see what the Venom box contains, as well as the one after that, before I decide whether or not to cancel the subscription.
The timing doesn't bother me as I am giving the majority of them for presents. The price is fine for an every 3 months charge, but including higher quality items in the box would be great.
label: neutral
